description: Use to delete the wind load cases the Wind Load Calculator wrote (EC1W_, C454W_); it is also the undo of ec_wind_apply. For other loads use civil_remove_loads. Removes what the Wind Load Calculator plugin writes: every EC1W_ and C454W_ load case, its load group, and their beam/pressure/nodal loads — whether this tool or the plugin window wrote them. Loads anyone else put on the same elements are kept. Previews unless apply: true.
name: ec_wind_remove
title: Remove the wind loads
